title: Missing Automated Tests
description: The project lacks comprehensive unit, integration, and E2E tests. Current test coverage is estimated to be below 5%, which poses a high risk for regressions during future development.

title: No CI/CD Implementation
description: There are no GitHub Actions or other CI/CD workflows to automate testing, building, or deployment. This slows down the release process and increases the chance of human error.

title: TypeORM Synchronize in Production
description: The backend currently relies on `synchronize: true` in TypeORM. This should be disabled in production in favor of migrations to prevent data loss and ensure predictable schema changes.

title: Inconsistent Naming Convention
description: There are remnants of snake_case in some API responses and database entities, though the project is transitioning towards camelCase. This inconsistency can lead to confusion in the frontend.

title: Hardcoded Configuration in Code
description: Some default values for sensitive keys (like JWT secrets) are hardcoded in the code as fallbacks if environment variables are missing. This is a security risk.

title: Low Error Handling Robustness
description: Frontend error handling is present but often relies on basic `alert()` or console logging, rather than a centralized, user-friendly notification system.
